findings.title: website_name leaks the website for TL0 users hidden from anonymous viewers
findings.body: `:website_name` is added to the public `attributes` list (line 43) and is not included in `untrusted_attributes` (lines 105-111). `website` is in that list, so for a TL0 user seen by anonymous/untrusted viewers the `website` key is suppressed. `website_name` is still serialized, with `include_website_name?` only checking `website.present?`. It returns the host and, for same-domain sites, the full path, so the hidden website is still exposed. The TL0 spec (spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb lines 11-14) does not list `website_name`, so the gap is not caught. Add `website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` or make `include_website_name?` respect `scope.restrict_user_fields?(object)`, and extend the spec.

findings.title: String mutation via `<<` on a literal in the subdomain check
findings.body: `discourse_host.ends_with?("." << website_host)` mutates the `"."` literal in place. It works today only because string literals are mutable and not frozen. It breaks under `# frozen_string_literal: true` or future Ruby defaults, and is a confusing construction. Use `"." + website_host` or interpolation.

findings.title: Path appended without checking it is present
findings.body: The same-domain and parent-domain branches concatenate `URI(website.to_s).path`, which can be nil for some parsed URIs. Also, `website_host` is computed with `rescue nil` but the URI is parsed again in each branch. Parse the URI once, guard the path, and fall back to the host when it is empty, so the result does not end in an unexpected nil or stray slash.

findings.title: Template depends on website_name, which is absent from some user payloads
findings.body: The template now checks `model.website_name` and renders it. The previous client-side `websiteName` computed derived the value from `model.website`. Any user object that does not come from UserSerializer (for example models built from other serializers or the current-user preload) will have no `website_name`, so the link disappears even when a website is set. Confirm all places that render this template load the full serializer, or keep a fallback.
